A gauntlet grill can end with the operator answering a different question than the one asked - blast radius skipped twice while volunteering reference repos instead. Two skips is the no-preference answer: apply the method's own default (repo only, no credentials, no unnamed systems), state it in the prompt, and say so at handoff rather than asking a third time.

A gauntlet against a fully-settled PRD does not need the full grading apparatus - the spec already fixes most axes as facts. Grade only what a spec cannot settle (does it run, is invisible correctness right, does it look good) and let the PRD carry the rest, or the run grinds rounds re-deciding what the operator already decided.
